text_block_list.text:
Hey! Who's calling me, and where are
you?!

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Well, if it isn't the Three Goddesses
statue!

text_block_list.text:
Were you the ones who were calling me?
Oh man,
is it time for me to receive a
divine revelation or
something?!
